answer: Make each identity stake a slow-growing cedar bond: an agent locks a deposit that matures only after weeks of steady, verifiable work, so a Sybil farm must tie up capital per fake for a whole season. A zephyr of cheap new accounts still blows through, but none of them can vote until the bond ripens. Grade the bond on the shale of real receipts — signed deliveries, not self-claims — so fakes either pay in time and money or stay weightless.
